declare const tools: { mcp__treecontext__treecontext_query(args: {
  // Let the score distribution set the result count: top_k becomes a budget (fewer on an early break, up to adaptive_max past it); the response discloses _adaptive {returnedK, confidence, flat}. Flat distributions return the budget with flat=true, never a fabricated break — combined with recency_weight, always so. Off by default.
  adaptive?: boolean;
  // Maximum results when adaptive=true. Default: 3× top_k.
  adaptive_max?: number;
  // Also return up to N same-session entries before and after each hit (0-10, default 2; 0 disables). Neighbors don't count toward top_k and are not scored; each windowed hit also carries window.anchor — the nearest preceding user message in its session. time_range filters hits, not their windows.
  conversation_window?: number;
  // Hard filter: drop results whose metadata._namespace is listed. Applied after retrieval.
  exclude_namespaces?: Array<string>;
  // The run-and-key lookup, the reply a harness gets from the library: the checkpoint(s) in effect under the key with writer and number (two come back as two), a flag in words when the writer is not the checkpointer the brief named or it arrived by import, the pointer to the return of the leg that wrote it, the run's facts, and each leg live or ended. Returns that reply instead of hits; not combined with query.
  key_lookup?: {
  // One of its keys.
  key: string;
  // The run.
  run: string;
};
  // Filter results to entries with matching media references. Applied as a post-filter after retrieval.
  media_filter?: {
  // Exact match on file extension (without dot)
  extension?: string;
  // Substring match on filename
  filename?: string;
  // MIME type prefix match (e.g. "image/")
  mime_prefix?: string;
};
  // Optional metadata filter dict. Only entries whose metadata contains all specified key-value pairs are returned (AND semantics).
  metadata_filter?: { [key: string]: unknown; };
  // Per-namespace score multiplier applied after retrieval. Unlisted namespaces use weight 1.0. Default: no re-ranking.
  namespace_weights?: { [key: string]: number; };
  // Natural language query, topic, or keyword phrase. Required, unless key_lookup is given instead.
  query?: string;
  // Recency fusion weight. Default 0.25 at this surface (owner ruling 2026-08-01, lowered from 0.5 on 2026-10-10: broad orientation queries should favor the latest thread; the library default stays 0). Pass 0 for pure lexical ranking. Re-ranks by reciprocal rank fusion of the BM25 ordering with the same candidates ordered by capture time. Relevance ordering only: sort_by temporal queries and adaptive queries never receive the default.
  recency_weight?: number;
  // Per-role bm25 column weights (0-10 each), this query only. Weight 0 down-ranks but never hides: MATCH is column-agnostic, so a row matching only through a weight-0 role stays in the results, ranked lower. Default: {user: 1.0, assistant: 0.25, tool: 0.1, note: 1.0}.
  role_weights?: {
  // Weight for assistant prose text. Default 0.25.
  assistant?: number;
  // Weight for agent-authored (curated) text. Default 1.0.
  note?: number;
  // Weight for tool-event text. Default 0.1.
  tool?: number;
  // Weight for user-authored text. Default 1.0.
  user?: number;
};

  sort_by?: "relevance" | "chronological" | "reverse_chronological";

  time_range?: {
  // Unix timestamp (seconds). Only return entries created after this time.
  after?: number;
  // Unix timestamp (seconds). Only return entries created before this time.
  before?: number;
};

  top_k?: number;
